'''Phadreas Kole''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. He had little involvement in politics, focusing instead on his [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] collection rather than the conversion of Rhinnal to Imperial standards.

==Biography==
Phadreas Kole was a moderate and passive [[Human/Legends|Human]] who had joined the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] after its rise.<ref name="JC" /> In its early [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the Empire granted the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] marginal independence, and the [[Darpa sector/Legends|Darpa sector's]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Jander Graffe]], installed Phadreas Kole as Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]] to ensure Rhinnal’s compliance with the precepts of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="CC" />

[[File:Rhinnal.jpg|250px|left|thumb|Phadreas Kole served as Imperial governor of Rhinnal, but did so without any ideological fervor]]
Nevertheless, life on [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] had changed very little with the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] – even less than elsewhere in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. As a former colony, the Rhinnalians had been accustomed to a certain lack of autonomy. People had not taken much notice when the moderate and benevolent [[Esseles/Legends|Esselian]] governor was replaced by an equally indifferent Imperial one.<ref name="JC" /> The locals had barely noticed Kole’s hands-off leadership. Opposition to [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine’s]] regime had remained muted, even among the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sympathizers at the [[Jedi chapter house (Rhinnal)|old chapter house]].<ref name="CC" />

Governor Phadreas Kole was an inoffensive man who had been far more interested in maintaining and restoring his vast collection of antique [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] than in making his mark on Rhinnalian history. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jander Graffe]] had urged him to crack down and make more of an effort to bring [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]] fully into the Imperial fold, but had not made much headway. Kole’s bureaucracy had remained quite small by Imperial standards. Public affairs on Rhinnal were mostly handled during periodical gatherings of clan heads when they were judged to be of little import to the outside galaxy, and by the governor when they were considered significant.<ref name="JC" /> However, while the locals had posed no threat to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], Kole’s Imperial masters had taken no notice of his inactivity.<ref name="FOP" />

Six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|fall]] of nearby [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had rattled the citizens of [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]]. An organized resistance movement overthrew Governor Kole two and a half years later.<ref name="CC" />
